issue.body:
## Outcome

Produce one end-to-end C-SDLC v3 remote delivery workflow.

## Primary deliverable

One end-to-end remote delivery workflow from an accepted PVF result to safe terminal cleanup.

## Verification result

One workflow proof reaches safe cleanup from an accepted PVF result, while refusal cases prove no intermediate step independently grants authority, for requirements 174 through 178.

## Unit boundary

Issue completion is exactly one remote delivery workflow; review, publication, PR, finish, and cleanup are non-closeable stages of that workflow.

## Dependencies

- V3-D: #503

## Retained predecessor scope

- #174
- #175
- #176
- #177
- #178

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Review binds exact immutable scope
- [ ] Publication modes are explicit
- [ ] Finish derives terminal truth
- [ ] Requirements 174 through 178 have positive and refusal proof

## Owned paths

- `csdlc-v3/src/commands/remote/**`
- `csdlc-v3/src/review/**`
- `csdlc-v3/src/publication/**`
- `csdlc-v3/tests/remote_commands/**`

## PVF lanes

- `pvf-denominator`
- `exact-review`
- `publication-linkage`
- `terminal-finish`
- `cleanup-safety`

## Stop conditions

- Review can be self-authorized
- Publication or finish can bypass typed gates

## Non-goals

- Authority cutover
- broad repository cleanup

## Canonical planning identity

- Planned ID: `V3-E`
- Canonical title: `[v0.92.1][V3-E] C-SDLC v3 remote delivery workflow`
